issues.description: The script intercepts and replays XMLHttpRequests using GM_xmlhttpRequest, but only to the same origin (character.ai). No evidence of exfiltration to third-party servers or data leak outside the matched domain.
issues.recommendation: Ensure users are aware that replaying requests can have side effects (already warned in the UI). No critical data exfiltration detected.

issues.description: The script requests GM_xmlhttpRequest permission, which is used only for replaying requests to the same origin. No over-privilege detected, but GM_xmlhttpRequest is a high-privilege API.
issues.recommendation: No action needed unless script is modified to target third-party endpoints.

issues.description: No evidence of code obfuscation, eval, or dynamic code execution. All code is readable and not minified.
No supply chain risk: no @require or external scripts loaded.
No privacy collection: script does not access cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, or fingerprinting APIs. It does not read form fields or clipboard.

summary: The script intercepts and replays up to 5 recent XMLHttpRequests made to character.ai, allowing the user to modify PATCH requests to use a specific model. It does not transmit data to third-party servers, does not collect sensitive user data, and does not use obfuscated or dynamically executed code. The main risk is the potential for unintended side effects when replaying requests, but this is clearly communicated to the user. No critical or high-severity security issues detected. Overall, the script is considered low risk for the reviewed version.
